entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So those strange pipes tunneling through[n]Mementos were originating from down[n]here after all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You know, I have been considering[n]this for some time... They remind[n]me somewhat of veins.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: More importantly, what's up with this[n]scenery? What kind of distortion is this?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I mean, what does everyone think this[n]world is...!?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Calm down, Lady Ann. The Treasure[n]is definitely here, and that's what's[n]important now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And I can sense something else.[n]A tremendous presence that's coming[n]from much deeper within...

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Makoto
